_readme: New KB entries, written or reviewed by a person. Format and rules: docs/KB_ENTRY_TEMPLATE.md; topics: docs/KB_COVERAGE.md. Check with: .venv/bin/python scripts/validate_kb.py. Only entries with status "approved" are used by the app; "draft" entries and the example ("example": true) never are. Draft answers are short paraphrases of the official page in source_url; empty answers are to be written.

questions: EXAMPLE: the question as a customer would type it
EXAMPLE: the same question, worded another way
EXAMPLE: a short or casual version of the same question
entries.answer: EXAMPLE: write the support answer here. Plain text, no greeting or sign-off; numbered steps only when the customer has to do something.
entries.notes: Optional: source or reviewer notes. Never shown to customers or the AI.

questions: How do I monitor SSL certificate expiry?
I did not get an alert before my SSL certificate expired
SSL monitor says the certificate is not trusted
collect: Exact status or error shown on the monitor
Whether the certificate is self-signed or uses intermediate certificates
entries.answer: Add an SSL/TLS Certificate monitor with the host and port (443 by default) and set an expiry threshold in days; you are notified that many days before the certificate expires. If the trust check fails, the usual causes are a self-signed certificate or a missing or wrong intermediate chain. If you check by IP address or a hostname that differs from the certificate, turn on Skip hostname verification.

questions: How do I get alerted before my domain expires?
domain expiry monitor setup
domain expiry monitor shows the wrong expiry date
collect: Expiry date shown versus the registrar's date
entries.answer: Add a Domain Expiry monitor with the registered domain (without subdomains) and an expiry threshold in days (30 by default). It checks about once a day from the primary location and alerts you that many days before the domain expires; Poll Now runs an immediate check.

questions: My ping monitor shows down but the server is up
How do I add a ping monitor?
ping monitor keeps timing out from some locations
collect: Whether ICMP is allowed by the host and firewalls
entries.answer: A Ping monitor sends three ICMP echo requests per poll and is marked down only when none of them get a reply, so the host and any firewall in between must allow ICMP from the monitoring locations. An IPv6 check does not fall back to IPv4; add a separate check if you need both.

questions: How do I monitor whether a TCP port is open?
port monitor shows down but the service is running
alert me when a port is closed
collect: Port status check setting (alert on closed or open)
entries.answer: A Port monitor checks that a TCP port on your host is reachable from the chosen locations, and can also check the response for required or forbidden keywords. It goes down when the port is closed or not listening (or open, if you set it to alert on open), or when the response fails your keyword rules. 10- and 15-second checks need an On-Premise Poller.

questions: How do I monitor DNS resolution for my domain?
DNS monitor shows answer mismatch
DNS monitor connection error
collect: DNS server, domain and record type checked
Expected values configured for answer validation
entries.answer: A DNS monitor queries your DNS server for a domain and record type (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS or TXT) over TCP or UDP. It alerts on failed lookups, connection timeouts, answers that don't match the values you expect, or a TTL above your limit; DNSSEC validation is optional.

questions: How do I monitor a login or checkout flow?
web transaction monitor fails at one step
how do I record a synthetic transaction?
collect: Monitor name and the step that fails
entries.answer: A Web Transaction (Browser) monitor replays a recorded user journey of up to 20 steps, such as a login or checkout, in a real browser from Site24x7 locations or an On-Premise Poller. Record the steps with the recorder, then set the browser, frequency, locations and alerts. Logins can use a credential profile, and TOTP-based multi-factor authentication is supported.

questions: How do I set up real user monitoring?
RUM shows no data after adding the script
where do I put the RUM snippet?
collect: Where the snippet was placed (header or footer)
entries.answer: Real User Monitoring is added by pasting the JavaScript snippet Site24x7 gives you into the header or footer of your web application's pages. It supports Chrome, Firefox, Safari and Opera, and single page apps built with Angular, Ember or React.

questions: How do I create a public status page?
status page setup
how do I show incidents on a status page?
collect: Whether it should be public or private
entries.answer: Status pages are created in StatusIQ: log in, click Add Status Page, enter a name (the other details are optional) and create it. A status page keeps your users informed about live incidents and scheduled maintenance; components are added separately.

questions: Which ports and domains does the agent need through our firewall?
agent cannot connect through firewall
what do I allowlist for the server agent?
collect: Data center or region of the account
entries.answer: The server monitoring agent only makes outbound HTTPS connections on port 443. Allow the Site24x7 hostnames for your data center: for the US data center that is plus.site24x7.com (plus2 and plus3 for disaster recovery), dms.zoho.com and logu.site24x7.com for logs. Accounts in other regions use other domain suffixes such as .eu or .in, and published IP ranges per data center are an alternative to hostnames.

questions: Which Site24x7 IPs should I allowlist?
our firewall blocks Site24x7 checks
website monitor down because of IP blocking
collect: Which monitor and locations are affected
Firewall or WAF in front of the site
Whether allowlisting is by IP or by domain
entries.answer: Resolve the domain site24x7.enduserexp.com, which maps to all monitoring locations, and build your firewall rules from it, or use the location IP list published in the help center. Allowlist all locations, because checks can come from another location while one is under maintenance; Site24x7 announces IP changes.

questions: How do I set a proxy for the Linux agent?
Linux agent behind a proxy is not reporting
change proxy settings on an installed Linux agent
collect: Proxy host and port, and whether it needs authentication
entries.answer: For an installed Linux agent, add the proxy details to the PROXY_INFO section of monagent.cfg in the agent's conf directory (under /opt/site24x7 for root installs, or the installing user's home for non-root installs), save it, and restart the agent with its monagent utility.

questions: How do I set a proxy for the Windows agent?
Windows agent not reporting behind a proxy
where are the proxy settings for the Windows agent?
collect: Proxy host and port, and whether it needs authentication
entries.answer: Right-click the agent's tray icon in the Windows taskbar, choose Proxy Configuration, enter the proxy server, port and (if needed) username and password, then restart the agent.

questions: How do I monitor servers inside my private network?
On-Premise Poller is not sending data
what is the On-Premise Poller for?
collect: Firewall or proxy between the poller and Site24x7
entries.answer: The On-Premise Poller monitors resources inside your network, behind a firewall or VPN, and sends the data to Site24x7. Browser-based web transaction and page speed monitors need the Linux poller, and network device monitoring needs the 64-bit version. Keep the poller on the latest version.

questions: How do I monitor MySQL?
MySQL monitor shows no data
what privileges does the MySQL monitoring user need?
collect: Exact error from the add-instance step or the monitor
entries.answer: MySQL is monitored by the Site24x7 Linux server agent, which discovers instances on the host; you then add the instance with the agent's add-instance command and a dedicated MySQL user. That user needs replication client, process and show databases rights, plus select and execute on performance_schema and sys. It needs MySQL 5.6 or later with agent 19.0.0 or later (MariaDB: agent 19.4.0 or later).

questions: How do I monitor SQL Server?
SQL Server monitor missing after installing the agent
does SQL Server monitoring need a login?
collect: Whether the instance appears under the server monitor
entries.answer: Install the Site24x7 Windows server agent on the SQL Server host; it discovers and adds SQL Server automatically. No SQL Server login is needed: the agent reads performance counters (read-only). It needs SQL Server 2008 or later and .NET 3.0 or later. If the monitor is missing, run Discover Applications from the Windows server monitor.

questions: How do I monitor an Oracle database?
Oracle monitor add instance fails
which privileges does the Oracle monitoring user need?
collect: Oracle version and whether it is multi-tenant
Exact error from the add-instance step
entries.answer: Oracle is monitored by the Site24x7 Linux server agent: create a read-only Oracle user with CREATE SESSION, CONNECT and SELECT_CATALOG_ROLE, then add each instance with the agent's add-instance command (host, port, service name, credentials). It supports Oracle 11g and later with agent 19.8.0 or later; the Instant Client is optional.

questions: How do I monitor PostgreSQL?
PostgreSQL monitor shows no data
which roles does the PostgreSQL monitoring user need?
collect: Exact error from the add-instance step
entries.answer: PostgreSQL is monitored by the Site24x7 Linux server agent, which discovers instances; add each one with the agent's add-instance command and a dedicated user. Grant that user execute on pg_ls_waldir and the pg_read_all_stats and pg_read_all_settings roles (plus CONNECT on restricted databases). It needs PostgreSQL 10.23 or later and agent 19.4.0 or later.

questions: How do I monitor VMware ESXi?
VMware monitor cannot connect to vCenter
what permissions does the VMware account need?
collect: vCenter or ESXi host and port
Exact error when adding the monitor
entries.answer: Install an On-Premise Poller first, then add a VMware ESX/ESXi monitor with the host and port and choose the poller as the location. Poll through a linked vCenter monitor or with the host's own credentials (a stored credential profile works). The VMware account needs a read-only or administrator role and access to the Managed Object Browser.

questions: How do I monitor Hyper-V?
Hyper-V VMs show only partial details
Hyper-V not discovered
collect: Windows Server version of the host
What is missing in the console
entries.answer: Install the Site24x7 Windows agent on the Hyper-V host; Hyper-V is discovered automatically. Full VM details need Windows Server 2012 or later (2008 and 2008 R2 show only state, health and CPU). Only admins or super admins can start, stop or restart VMs from the console.

questions: How do I store SSH credentials for monitoring?
use an SSH private key for a monitor
update a password used by several monitors
collect: Exact error when testing or polling
entries.answer: Store login details in a credential profile (Admin > Configuration Profiles > Credential Profile > Add Credential) and pick it when adding or editing a monitor, so a password change applies everywhere. SSH can use a private key (with an optional key password) or a certificate.

which account do I use for WMI monitoring?
agentless Windows server shows access denied
collect: Whether the server is in a domain or a workgroup
Account type used (domain user, local user)

questions: How do I connect my AWS account?
AWS integration not discovering resources
do I need access keys for AWS monitoring?
entries.answer: Site24x7 connects to AWS mainly through a cross-account IAM role (Role ARN), which gives it temporary access; a CloudFormation template can create the role and link it for you. Control Tower, IAM Identity Center and delegated admin are options for connecting many accounts.

questions: How do I connect Google Cloud?
GCP monitor shows permission error
which roles does the GCP service account need?
collect: Roles granted to the service account
entries.answer: Create a Google Cloud service account, grant it the Viewer role (plus Browser for organization-level monitoring), export its JSON key and upload it with the project ID under Cloud > Add GCP Monitor. Resources are polled every five minutes; starting or stopping VMs needs the compute instance start/stop permissions.

questions: I am not receiving alert emails
Site24x7 alert emails go to spam
alert emails stopped arriving
collect: When the last alert email arrived
entries.answer: Check the spam or junk folder and add no-reply@site24x7.com and noreply@zohoaccounts.com to your allow list, and make sure your mail servers are working. Each address can receive up to 500 alert emails a day; after that, alerts pause until the count resets at midnight.

questions: I am not receiving SMS alerts
SMS alerts stopped
added my mobile number but get no SMS
collect: User alert group the user belongs to
Whether the number is on a Do Not Disturb list
entries.answer: Make sure the user's mobile number is linked to the right user alert group under Admin > User & Alert Management, and enter it without a zero after the country code. SMS goes through bulk providers, so a number on a Do Not Disturb list may not receive it.

questions: How do I send alerts to a webhook?
webhook integration not receiving alerts
can a webhook call an internal URL?
entries.answer: Add a Webhooks integration under Admin > Third-Party Integration with the hook URL, HTTP method and body format (headers and authentication are optional) and pick which statuses trigger it. Use Save and Test to send a test alert. For an endpoint reachable only inside your network, set it to Internal and route it through an On-Premise Poller.

questions: How do I send alerts to Microsoft Teams?
Teams integration stopped posting
Teams connector deprecated
collect: Whether the old connector-based setup was used
entries.answer: In the Teams channel, tag the Site24x7 Bot and use its Configure Integration card, then name the integration, choose the monitors, triggers and alert groups, and use Save and Test. Alerts and root cause details are posted to the channel. The old connector-based integration is deprecated.

questions: How do I send alerts to Slack?
Slack integration not posting alerts
test Slack alerts
collect: Connection type (webhook URL or OAuth token)
entries.answer: Create a Slack app with the needed permissions, then connect it under Admin > Third-Party Integration with a webhook URL or an OAuth token and channel ID. Down, up and trouble alerts are posted with RCA links; use Save and Test to check it.

questions: How do I stop alerts during maintenance?
schedule a recurring maintenance window
got alerts during a maintenance window
entries.answer: Create a window under Admin > Operations > Scheduled Maintenance: name, time zone, frequency (once, daily, weekly, monthly or yearly), timing, and the monitors or groups. Alerts are suppressed during the window. Recurring windows must be shorter than 24 hours, and an active window's timing can't be changed until it ends.

questions: What can each user role do?
change a user's role
read only user cannot edit monitors
entries.answer: Super Admins have full control including billing; Admins have the same except billing. Operators manage their own maintenance windows and reports, Read Only users can view most modules, and Alert Contacts only receive alerts. Choose the role when adding a user; you can change it only after they accept the invitation.

questions: How do I enable two-factor authentication?
turn on MFA for my organization
2FA for Site24x7 login
collect: Whether it is for one user or the whole organization
Role of the person enabling it
entries.answer: Go to Admin > My Account and turn on multi-factor authentication; you are taken to Zoho Directory, where you open Multi-Factor Authentication in the side menu and choose an MFA mode.

questions: How do I set up SSO with SAML?
SAML login not working
can I use Okta or Azure AD to sign in?
collect: Whether the person is the Super Admin
entries.answer: Only the account's Super Admin can set up SAML SSO, in Zoho Accounts under Preferences > Settings > SAML Authentication. You need your identity provider's login, logout and password-change URLs and its signing certificate (Base64 .cer, .crt, .cert or .pem). The Super Admin keeps a password login for recovery.

questions: How do I add a customer to my MSP account?
MSP customer did not get the invitation
MSP user cannot see a customer account
collect: Whether the customer verified their mobile number
Which MSP users are associated with the customer
entries.answer: In the MSP account, add the customer from the Customers page with their company and contact details. The customer gets an invitation email and joins as a sub-user with the MSP Customer role; their data appears after they verify their mobile number. Only MSP users associated with that customer can access it.

questions: What is Zia in Site24x7?
how do I enable Zia?
Zia not available in my account
collect: Which integration method is set up (BYOK, ZKS, Azure OpenAI)
entries.answer: Zia is Zoho's AI assistant in Site24x7: it can summarize alarms, investigate outages, compare root cause analyses and explain error codes. Enable it with one of three methods (Bring Your Own Key, Zoho Key Services or Microsoft Azure OpenAI), accept the data privacy notice, then pick a provider and model.

questions: Error when adding a REST API monitor
API monitor will not save
invalid data provided error for an API monitor
collect: A HAR file of the failing add-monitor attempt, with cookies and tokens removed
entries.answer:
Support may ask for a HAR file, which records the requests your browser makes. Right-click the page where the error happens, choose Inspect (Inspect Element in Safari), and open the Network tab. Then:
Chrome or Edge: in the Network tab, turn on "Preserve log", repeat the failing action, then right-click a request and choose "Save all as HAR with content".
Firefox: in the Network tab, open the Network settings (gear icon) and select "Persist Logs", repeat the failing action, then right-click a request and choose "Save All As HAR".
Safari: if the Develop menu is missing, turn on Safari > Settings > Advanced > Show features for web developers; open Develop > Show Web Inspector, go to the Network tab, repeat the failing action, then click Export.
A HAR file can contain cookies and tokens, so attach it only to your support ticket and don't share it anywhere else.

questions: How do I install the Site24x7 agent on a Linux server?
how to add a linux server monitor
set up monitoring for my linux box with the agent
add a monitor in the monitoring agent on linux
collect: Whether the agent must run as root or non-root
Exact error shown by the install command, if any
entries.answer:
1. Go to Server > Server Monitor > Servers (+) > Linux (or Admin > Inventory > Add Monitor > Linux Server Monitoring).
2. Use the toggle to choose whether the agent is installed and run as root or non-root.
3. Click Copy to Clipboard, then paste and run the commands on your server to download and install the agent. The same commands work on 32-bit and 64-bit systems.
4. Once the agent is installed, the server appears under Server > Server Monitor > Servers.
entries.notes: Draft from the official page in source_url, fetched 2026-11-04. Only steps the page states; check the page before approving.

questions: How do I install the Site24x7 agent on a Windows server?
how to add a windows server monitor
set up windows server monitoring with the agent
where do I download the windows agent
collect: Exact error shown by the installer, if any
entries.answer:
1. Go to Server > Server Monitor > Servers (+) > Windows.
2. Click Download Site24x7 Windows Server Agent, review the license agreement and click I Accept.
3. Open the downloaded installer and, when prompted, enter the device key shown on the Add a Windows Server page.
4. If your organization policy requires it, enter the proxy configuration, then choose the installation folder.
5. Once the agent is installed, the server appears under Server > Server Monitor > Servers.
entries.notes: Draft from the official page in source_url, fetched 2026-11-04. Only steps the page states; check the page before approving.

questions: How do I add a website monitor?
how to monitor my website uptime
add a URL to monitor
set up a website check
collect: Error shown by Check and Save, if any
entries.answer:
1. Go to Web > Website (+).
2. Enter a Display Name and the Webpage URL to monitor.
3. Choose the Check Frequency.
4. Choose the Monitoring Locations; at least one primary location is required.
5. Click Save, or Check and Save to test the configuration before saving.

questions: How do I generate a report?
how to create a custom report
make a report of my monitors' metrics
how do I export a report as CSV
collect: What the report should show (monitors and metrics)
entries.answer:
1. Go to Reports > Custom Report (Beta) and click +Create Custom Report.
2. Choose a Category; all monitors in that category are included.
3. Click the pencil icon to enter the Report name and Description.
4. Under Columns, add the Attributes and Resources and set the Time period; under Filter, add any Inventory Filter or Data Filter.
5. Click Save to open the report in Sheet View.
6. To export it, click Share This and choose Export CSV, or Email to send it now.
entries.notes: Draft from the official page in source_url, fetched 2026-11-04. Only steps the page states; check the page before approving.

questions: How do I schedule a report to be emailed?
how to send a weekly report automatically
set up a scheduled report in PDF
email reports every month
collect: How often it should be sent
entries.answer:
1. Go to Admin > Report Settings > Scheduled Reports and click Schedule Report.
2. Enter a Display Name and choose the Report Type (Preview shows the report first).
3. Choose the resource type and the Report Format: CSV or PDF.
4. Set the Reporting Period, the Frequency (daily, weekly, monthly or quarterly) and the Reporting Time.
5. Under Send Report to, choose the contact or user alert group.
6. Click Save, or Send Now to send the report straight away.
entries.notes: Draft from the official page in source_url, fetched 2026-11-04. Only steps the page states; check the page before approving.

questions: How do I add a user to my account?
how to invite a team member
add a new user and give them a role
create a login for a colleague
collect: Whether the user is outside the organization
entries.answer:
1. Go to Admin > User and Alert Management > Users and Alerts and click Add User.
2. Enter the Contact Name and Email (a Mobile Number is needed for SMS and voice alerts).
3. Choose a User Role for each product and the resources under Allowed to Access.
4. Under Associate to User Groups, pick a user alert group, and choose the Notify Medium.
5. Click Save. A contact outside your organization gets an invitation email to create an account.
Adding users needs Organization Account Admin rights; Super Admin alone is not enough.
entries.notes: Draft from the official page in source_url, fetched 2026-11-04. Only steps the page states; check the page before approving. ACCOUNT is a high-risk category: the AI answers it only above the stricter confidence bar.

questions: How do I configure alerts and notifications?
how to set up a notification profile
choose how and when alerts are sent
set an alert delay or escalation
entries.answer:
A notification profile decides when and how alerts go out.
1. Go to Admin > Configuration Profiles > Notification Profile and select Add Notification Profile.
2. Enter a Display Name.
3. Under Alert Configuration, choose for each status the alerting period and one or more notification mediums.
4. Optionally set a Notification Delay (polls to wait before alerting), a Persistent Alert and Escalation Settings.
5. Click Save. Every monitor must be associated with a notification profile; you can use the default one.
entries.notes: Draft from the official page in source_url, fetched 2026-11-04. Only steps the page states; check the page before approving.

questions: How do I choose who receives alerts?
how to create a user alert group
send alerts to my team
add people to an alert group
entries.answer:
A user alert group decides who receives a monitor's alerts.
1. Go to Admin > User and Alert Management > User Alert Group and click Add Group.
2. Enter a Display Name and choose the Product.
3. Under Add Users, pick the users. Users must first be added under Users & Alerts > Add User.
4. Click Save.
A user alert group is chosen when you add or edit a monitor, and each group needs at least one user.
entries.notes: Draft from the official page in source_url, fetched 2026-11-04. Only steps the page states; check the page before approving.

questions: How do I create a monitor group?
how to group my monitors
add monitors to a group
organize monitors by application
collect: Which monitors go in the group
Whether subgroups or a dependency are needed
entries.answer:
1. Go to Admin > Inventory > Monitor Groups and click the (+) icon, or choose Create Group from the dropdown in the top-right corner.
2. Enter a Display name and Description.
3. Under Select Monitors, choose at least one monitor; the group's status is based on its monitors.
4. Optionally add Subgroups (comma-separated names), a Dependency Configuration and the User Alert Group for the group.
5. Click Save. The group appears in the Monitor Groups list.
entries.notes: Draft from the official page in source_url, fetched 2026-11-04. Only steps the page states; check the page before approving.

questions: How do I add my iOS app for monitoring?
how to monitor an iPhone app
set up mobile APM for iOS
add an IOS app
collect: Error shown by pod install or the build, if any
entries.answer:
1. Go to the iOS section under the APM tab and click Add Application.
2. Enter an application name and an Apdex threshold, then save.
3. On the application screen, click the hamburger icon next to the app name to copy the application key.
4. Add pod 'Site24x7APM' to your Podfile inside your target block, then run pod install.
5. In your AppDelegate's didFinishLaunchingWithOptions, start the SDK with your application key: S24APM.start(withAppKey:"App_Key", interval: 15)
entries.notes: Draft from the official page in source_url, fetched 2026-11-04. Only steps the page states; check the page before approving.

questions: How do I add my Android app for monitoring?
how to monitor an android app
set up mobile APM for Android
add an android application
collect: Error shown by the Gradle build, if any
entries.answer:
1. Go to the Android OS section under the APM tab and click Add Application.
2. Enter an application name and an Apdex threshold, then click Save.
3. On the application screen, click the hamburger icon near the application name and copy the key.
4. In your app-level build.gradle, add implementation 'com.zoho.site24x7:mobileapm:2.2.2', and add https://maven.zohodl.com to the repositories blocks.
5. In onCreate() of your Application subclass, call Apm.startMonitoring(getApplicationContext(), "appKey", uploadInterval), then build the project.

questions: How do I add an APM monitor?
how to set up APM Insight for my .NET application
install the APM agent on my IIS server
monitor my ASP.NET app performance
collect: Error shown by the installer, if any
entries.answer:
These steps are for the APM Insight .NET agent on Windows.
1. Go to APM > APM Insight, click the .NET tab and download the agent .msi file.
2. Run the .msi file, click Browse to choose the installation folder, and click Next.
3. Under Startup Options, check Start the Agent if it should start after installation, and click Next.
4. In the .NET Agent Configuration window, paste the license key from the APM Insight home page and click Save.
5. All ASP.NET applications on the server are then monitored; data should appear on the APM Insight Edition page within a few minutes.
entries.notes: Draft from the official page in source_url, fetched 2026-11-04. Only steps the page states; check the page before approving. Other languages (Java, Node.js, Ruby, ...) have their own help pages; add entries for them separately.
